# img2pdf: Image to PDF Scanner — Full Documentation

## Summary
img2pdf is a free, privacy-first iOS app developed by Quan Dang that turns photos, receipts, paper documents, and scans into clean, small PDFs entirely on your iPhone or iPad. It requires iOS 18.0 or later, needs no account, has no tracking, works 100% offline, and never adds a watermark.

---

## 1. Product Overview: img2pdf Home

### What It Does
- Three ways in: scan paper pages with the built-in document scanner (with auto edge detection and shadow removal), snap photos with the camera, or pick pictures from your photo library. You can also import existing PDFs from the Files app.
- Visual page ordering: Drag and drop thumbnails to reorder pages, reverse page sequence, or sort chronologically by photo capture date.
- Paper sizes & layouts: Format documents to standard US Letter, A4, Legal, or original image aspect ratios. Place 1, 2, or 4 images on each sheet in a clean grid.
- Image enhancements: Four-corner perspective correction, rotation, brightness and contrast tuning, and automatic document filters that clean up paper scans.
- Searchable text (OCR): On-device text recognition embeds an invisible text layer into the PDF, making it searchable in any PDF viewer. You can also copy, edit, or export recognized text as a .txt file.
- Sign & annotate: Draw your signature with your finger in black, blue, or red, add dates, initials, checkmarks, and text fields directly onto any page. All annotations are flattened into the PDF.
- Permanent redactions: Black out private financial or personal details. Redactions are burned directly into the page raster and cannot be recovered.
- Compression presets: Small, Standard, and Best quality presets show exact file size estimates before sharing so attachments fit in emails.
- Password protection: Secure sensitive files with standard 128-bit AES encryption upon export.
- 100% private & offline: No account required, no analytics, no ads, and zero cloud uploads.

### Home Page FAQ
Q: Does img2pdf add a watermark to my PDF?
A: No. There is no watermark on any exported PDF. An optional text watermark is available in the export settings if you choose to turn it on, but it is disabled by default.

Q: Do my photos get uploaded to a cloud server?
A: No. All conversion, cropping, text recognition, and signing happen locally on your iPhone. The app works 100% offline, requires no account, and collects zero data.

Q: Can I make the exported PDF searchable?
A: Yes. img2pdf includes on-device OCR that detects text on your pages and writes it as an invisible text layer in the PDF, allowing you to search and select words.

Q: Can I sign documents or fill out forms before exporting?
A: Yes. You can draw signatures, add dates, initials, checkmarks, and text boxes directly onto any page. All annotations are permanently flattened into the PDF.

Q: How does img2pdf keep PDF file sizes small for email?
A: img2pdf offers Small, Standard, and Best quality presets with an instant file size estimate before sharing, so you can email documents without exceeding attachment limits.

---

## 2. Guide: How to Turn Photos into PDF on iPhone with No Watermark

### Free Built-in iOS Methods
1. Apple's Document Scanner (Files and Notes apps):
   - In Files: Open Files, choose your destination folder, tap More (...) > Scan Documents. Position the camera over the paper. The camera detects edges automatically. Tap Save to store an unwatermarked PDF.
   - Reference: Apple official support guide "How to scan documents on your iPhone or iPad" (https://support.apple.com/en-us/108963).
2. Photos App Print-to-PDF Gesture:
   - Select photos in the Photos app, tap Share, tap Print. In the Print Options preview, pinch outward with two fingers on the preview thumbnail. The preview expands into a full PDF reader. Tap Share to save or email the watermark-free PDF.
   - Reference: Apple official guide "Print from iPhone" (https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/print-from-iphone-iph3e2e3f5d/ios).
3. Apple Files Create PDF Action:
   - In Files, select multiple images, tap More (...), and choose Create PDF.

---

## 3. Guide: How to Convert JPG to PDF on iPhone: 3 Free Built-in Methods

### The 3 Built-in Methods
1. Apple Files App Quick Action:
   - Save JPGs to Files, tap Select, select the images, tap More (...) > Create PDF.
2. Photos App Print-to-PDF Gesture:
   - Select the JPG in Photos, tap Share > Print, pinch out on the preview thumbnail, and tap Share.
3. Apple Shortcuts Automation:
   - Create a Shortcut with Select Photos > Make PDF > Share.

---

## 4. Guide: How to Combine Multiple Photos into One PDF on iPhone

### Key Techniques
- Visual drag-and-drop page reordering.
- Reverse order or sort chronologically by capture timestamp.
- 1, 2, or 4 images per sheet grid layouts.
- Output compression with live size estimates before sharing.

---

## 5. Comparisons Directory

### img2pdf vs Apple Notes Scanner
- Apple Notes is pre-installed and integrates directly with iCloud notes.
- img2pdf adds visual page sorting, standard US Letter/A4 layouts, email compression size estimates, on-device OCR layer, and permanent redactions.

### img2pdf vs Adobe Scan
- Adobe Scan integrates with Adobe Creative Cloud and Acrobat, but requires an Adobe ID and uploads documents to Adobe Document Cloud servers.
- img2pdf is 100% on-device with zero sign-ups, works completely offline, and includes free compression controls.

### img2pdf vs Genius Scan
- Genius Scan (The Grizzly Labs) provides enterprise cloud auto-exports and MDM support, but locks OCR text recognition and PDF encryption behind a paid Genius Scan+ upgrade.
- img2pdf includes on-device OCR, password protection, and compression presets completely free.

### img2pdf vs iLovePDF
- iLovePDF offers a broad cloud tool suite for converting Word/Excel to PDF across web browsers.
- img2pdf is a native, private iPhone scanner that never uploads documents to third-party web servers and enforces zero daily task quotas.

### img2pdf vs Smallpdf
- Smallpdf offers multi-user e-signing and team workspaces, but enforces strict daily usage limits on free users before demanding a $12/month Pro subscription.
- img2pdf offers unlimited free on-device conversions with complete privacy and offline functionality.

### img2pdf vs Online Web PDF Converters
- Web upload tools require transmitting sensitive documents across the web to third-party servers.
- img2pdf processes all files inside the native iOS sandbox with zero uploads and works without an internet connection.
